results.name: Mahavira
results.description:
Mahavira, Jnn, Gujarat, India, 1470, Jasper, represents the 24th tirthankara or spiritual master of Jainism. Museum of Cinquentenaire (Brussels, Belgium). Made with ReMake and ReCap from AutoDesk.

Jainism, traditionally known as Jain Dharma, is an ancient Indian religion. Jainism followers are called "Jains", a word derived from the Sanskrit word jina and connoting the path of victory in crossing over life's stream of rebirths through an ethical and spiritual life. Jains trace their history through a succession of twenty-four victorious saviors and teachers known as Tirthankaras, with the first being Rishabhanatha, who is believed to have lived millions of years ago, and twenty-fourth being the Mahavira around 500 BCE. 

For more updates, please follow @GeoffreyMarchal on Twitter.

results.name: Egyptian god Thoth as baboon
results.description:
Thot is the god of the moon, writing, science and magic in Egyptian mythology. It is represented either as a man with the head of an ibis or a baboon, but can also appear entirely in the form of the ibis or as here of the sitting baboon. 

In the collection of the Egyptian Museum of the University of Bonn.

**Inv. no.** Ro22

**Scan** with Artec Leo, postprocessing in Blender and Substance Designer.

results.name: ENS - main entrance (Scaniverse)
results.description:
Entrance of the historic building of the ENS, at 45, rue d'Ulm. The inscriptions on the pediment of the monumental doorway display the school's two dates of creation (the first, 9 brumaire an III (30 October 1794), in the oculus, under the National Convention, the second, 17 March 1808), and the date of dedication of this building, 24 April 1841.

Above the entrance door are sculptures of two female figures who respectively represent letters and sciences. They are portrayed sitting on either side of a medallion of Minerva, who represents wisdom. 

📍 [École Normale Supérieure - PSL, Paris, Île-de-France, France](https://scaniver.se/L48.84205,2.34438)

![](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/7/79/Entr%C3%A9e_ENS_45_rue_d%27ulm.JPG)

Scanned with the iPhone12 Pro and Scaniverse. Please feel free to follow my collections of daily scans ([link](https://skfb.ly/6YuwK)). Follow me on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/emmanuel_2m)

results.name: Musician with a Rattle
results.description:
Ceramic figure known as "The Musician", representing a man sitting with his legs crossed and holding a rattle with his left hand. The character wears paint on his face (red and yellow), ornaments on his arms, and a three-strand necklace (with clay balls applied). His ears are pierced with expanders with decorated edges. He wears a helmet or cap and a loincloth tied at the back. His back shows visible vertebrae or body decoration with piercing, inlay and scarring.
 IDAEH Cultural Property No. 1.2.179.0064
www.fundacionrutamaya.org

Special thanks to the staff of La Ruta Maya Foundation for their hard work on this project.

3D model made in RealityScan; Total # of images: 306

results.name: Stacked Weathered Terra Cotta Garden Pots
results.description:
High-Fidelity Raw Scan (1M+ Tris) - Nanite Ready

A raw, high-poly photogrammetry scan of a stack of terra cotta planters. The pots feature authentic weathering, including efflorescence (white salt bloom), dirt residue, and chipped rims, sitting on a wooden surface.

This "clutter" asset is perfect for populating greenhouses, garden sheds, backyards, or flower shop scenes in Unreal Engine 5. It captures the uneven, organic look of used pottery.

Asset Details:

    Authentic Weathering: Features realistic salt stains and wear.

    Set Dressing: Pre-stacked for instant environment filling.

    Material: Unglazed red clay/terra cotta.

Technical Specs:

    Texture: 4096x4096 (4K)

    Polys: ~1,000,000 (Source Data)

    Maps: Albedo, Normal, Roughness, AO.

results.name: Queen Victoria and Prince Albert Courting
results.description:
Name: "Staffordshire Figures of Queen Victoria and Prince Albert Courting"
Author: Staffordshire Pottery
Date: 19th century
Material: Stafforshire
Dimensions: 18H x 8.5W x 13L cm
Place/Publisher: Staffordshire, England
Donor: Marsha M. Manns 2023
Description: Two Staffordshire Figured. Queen Victoria is sitting down with a lute while Prince Albert is standing with his arm around Victoria's shoulders, right leg crossed over his left, and left arm resting on his hip.
Notes: Not sure the connection to Byron other than that Queen Victoria was close with Lord Melborn and Lord Byron had an affair with Lord Melborn's wife.


Scanned by Cat Maida and Nicholas Kilgore at Drew University on June 9th, 2023.

results.name: S017_ChairOnTheDocks
results.description:
**S017_ChairOnTheDocks**  
*Binnenhavenhof  
51.901445 N, 4.513909 E
Apr 29, 03:47 PM


The first scan was captured behind the [Shurgard Self Storage Rotterdam Feijenoord](https://goo.gl/maps/PcscjbLmGLqeEM1p9). The wicker chair, in this industrial context which used to be a naval loading zone for barges, stood out to the group as a potential marker, annotation, indicating an appreciated leisure spot for individuals working there. Striking in its placement and material contrast, it seemed to be a great first scan. Behind the chair and figure sitting in it, can be seen a cropped piece of the fence separating the lot from the water, onto which the color of the [Nieuwe Maas](https://nl.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nieuwe_Maas) was transferred.


***

Captured during The Porous City workshop from the What a Mess workshop series.

[whatamess.city](http://whatamess.city/)

results.name: Photoscan Doll Figurine & Basket - Nursery Decor
results.description:
A high-fidelity 3D scan of a vintage-style resin figurine featuring a baby (or cherub) sitting next to a woven basket. The figure is holding a teddy bear and is accompanied by an alphabet block and a hanging baby bottle detail.

The basket section is hollow, likely designed as a pen holder, planter, or trinket dish. This asset captures the soft, hand-painted aesthetic of collectible nursery decor. It is ideal for populating shelves in domestic environments, antique shops, or adding a touch of nostalgia (or uneasiness) to game levels.

Asset Details:

    Vintage Aesthetic: Captures the "Precious Moments" style popular in 90s/00s home decor.

    Intricate Details: Features a textured basket, alphabet block, and fabric folds on the basket liner.

    Material: Realistic hand-painted resin texture with natural wear.

Technical Specs:

    Texture Resolution: 4096x4096 (4K)
    
    Poly Count: 1,000,000 Triangles

    Maps Included: Albedo, Normal, Roughness, AO.

results.name: Lekythos | NCMA Explore

user.displayName: NCMA Explore | North Carolina Museum of Art

results.description:
Lekythos

Created circa 375–350 BCE

Pentelic marble

18 1/4 x 9 3/4 x 9 3/4 inches

Ancient Greek

This lekythos features an engraving of a man and a woman. The inscription lists their names. The man sitting in the chair is Polyarchos. The woman shaking his hand is Polyxena. Their relationship to one another is unknown. The handshake depicted on this lekythos had a special meaning in ancient Greece. The Greeks referred to a handshake as dexiosis, or “engagement of the right hand.”

https://learn.ncartmuseum.org/artwork/lekythos/

results.name: Persian Glazed Ceramic Tile
results.description:
The scan of the Persian Ceramic Tile (1978.012.194) from the [Grinnell College Museum of Art](https://www.grinnell.edu/campus-life/arts-culture/museum) was made on 06/04/2024 with the Creaform Academia 50 handheld 3D scanner and edited in VXelements and VXModel 10 with minor texture map editing and converting done in GIMP. Unknown artist, 17th - 18th century. Glazed ceramic. Gift of Clinton A. Rehling '39.

"Clinton A. Rehling ’36 was both an alum and a professor at Grinnell College, as well as a significant donor to the permanent collection, who donated most of the non-Kelekian historic artifacts and over 300 works in various media, including an ancient Greek Tragic mask from 400 BCE and a Chinese sitting Buddha from 512 BCE. He is also a close acquaintance of Nanette Kelekian, and some of the objects he donated to the college are originally speculated to be purchased from the Kelekians—such as this Persian blue tile panel." --Lal Verda Karaoğlu, Grinnell College, Class of 2025

results.name: Rooftop Concrete Support Block & Sealant
results.description:
High-Fidelity Raw Scan (1M+ Tris) - Nanite Ready

A raw, high-poly photogrammetry scan of a concrete support block (sleeper/ballast) on a flat commercial roof. The scan captures the heavy application of white roofing sealant (mastic/elastomeric coating) used to waterproof the base, sitting on a weathered bitumen/tar and gravel surface.

This asset is essential for adding realistic maintenance details to rooftop scenes, HVAC areas, or urban environments in Unreal Engine 5.

Asset Details:

    Roofing Detail: Realistic, messy application of waterproof sealant and tar.

    Surface Texture: Weathered concrete block and granule-surfaced roofing membrane.

    Context: Perfect for populating empty roof spaces.

Technical Specs:

    Texture: 4096x4096 (4K)

    Polys: ~1,000,000 (Source Data)

    Maps: Albedo, Normal, Roughness, AO.

results.name: Granite sculpture of a dog
results.description:
**The sculpture depicts a simplified image of a small dog in a sitting position. It is made of stone (probably white granite) and is located on a wall next to the stairs. Its texture is uneven and heavily rough. The author of the sculpture is unknown, it was exhibited as part of the Lublin Artists' Meetings between 1976-1979.**

Photogrammetric scan (58 x 12MP 4:3); captured 02 May 2023, converted to low-poly triangular mesh (12.6k faces); processed in Metashape, editing and decimation done in blender, model includes:

* 2k 80%JPG diffuse texture
* 1k 80%JPG normal map
* 1k 80%JPG ambient occlusion

Size: ~ 0.5 x 0.5 x 0.5 meters

Artwork located in Lublin, Poland (https://osm.org/go/0kBUIaXYe?m=)

![](https://i.imgur.com/PgR50Yk.png)
